heading: A bit about who I am
paragraphs: I'm a Full Stack Developer with 4+ years of experience building fast, responsive and secure web applications with React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js and Express.

I've worked on numerous projects across e-commerce, fintech and healthcare, from clean, intuitive interfaces to the REST and GraphQL APIs and MongoDB/PostgreSQL databases behind them, writing code that other developers enjoy working with.
I enjoy owning features end to end: designing the data model, building the API and shipping the UI that brings it all together.
